points.text: Order fractions and find a fraction of a quantity (1.2D).

Convert recurring decimals into fractions (1.3A, Higher).
Round to a given number of significant figures or decimal places (1.8B).
Use estimation to approximate and check calculations (1.8D).

Collect like terms, expand a single bracket and take out common factors (2.2B to 2.2D).
Expand the product of two or more linear expressions (2.2A, Higher).

units.title: Set language, notation and Venn diagrams

points.text: Understand sets, the universal set and the empty set, with their symbols (1.5A, 1.5C).
Use the notation for union, intersection, element of and complement (1.5B, 1.5D).
Represent sets with Venn diagrams (1.5E).
Understand sets defined algebraically and subsets (1.5A, Higher).
Use n(A) and Venn diagrams with numbers of elements, including practical situations (1.5B to 1.5D, Higher).

Find perimeters and areas of sectors of circles (4.9A, Higher).
Find surface areas of simple shapes and of a cylinder (4.10C, 4.10D).
